Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

adjourn verb

also adjournment, postpone (a hearing), defer (a case), postpone a hearing

classical

Cic. Verr. 2.1.26: lēx ampliandī facit potestātem (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 193
Cic. Caecin. 29: potestās ampliandī (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 269

ampliō, ampliāre, ampliāvī, ampliātum

verb, first conjugation

adjourn (a case) for further hearing

A Roman court adjourned by pronouncing amplius, “more (hearing needed)”.

Other words

  • differō, differre, distulī, dīlātum — put off, postpone

    verb, conjugation · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. differō

  • prōferō, prōferre, prōtulī, prōlātum — defer, adjourn

    verb, conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 13.14.1: auctiōnis diem laxius prōferre (Lewis & Short s.v. prōferō)

See also court, trial.
